scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Mighty Hammer]
Unlike others, I am a blacksmith who refines a very limited number of items.
I refine only items that are ^CC0000+7 to +9^000000.
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 巨力鐵錘]
與別人不同，我只精煉數量有限的物品。
我只精煉^CC0000+7到+9^000000的物品。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Mighty Hammer]
My specialty is that even if my refining fails, the refine level decreases by 1 without losing the gear. Isn't it great?
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 巨力鐵錘]
我的特長是，即使精煉失敗，精煉等級只會降低1級，裝備不會消失。是不是很厲害？

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Mighty Hammer]
So lets kick this into overdrive, what d' ya say? What item do you want to refine?
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 巨力鐵錘]
那就讓我們火力全開吧，怎麼樣？你想精煉什麼物品？

scripts.text: [Blacksmith Mighty Hammer]
scripts.translation: [鐵匠 巨力鐵錘]

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Mighty Hammer]
I'm a blacksmith, not a hairstylist.
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 巨力鐵錘]
我是鐵匠，不是理髮師。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Mighty Hammer]
With my hammer, I will make you a star of the sky.
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 巨力鐵錘]
用我的鐵錘，我會讓你成為天空中的明星。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Mighty Hammer]
Making artificial hands is not my specialty.
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 巨力鐵錘]
製作假手不是我的專長。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Mighty Hammer]
Bring out the item so I can refine it!
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 巨力鐵錘]
把物品拿出來，讓我精煉它！

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Mighty Hammer]
Where is this foot odor coming from?
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 巨力鐵錘]
這腳臭味是從哪裡來的？

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Mighty Hammer]
Where is the accessory?
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 巨力鐵錘]
飾品在哪裡？

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Mighty Hammer]
What do you want me to refine?
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 巨力鐵錘]
你想讓我精煉什麼？

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Mighty Hammer]
Huh? What do you want me to do?
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 巨力鐵錘]
嗯？你想讓我做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Mighty Hammer]
This item can't be refined.
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 巨力鐵錘]
這個物品無法精煉。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Mighty Hammer]
I only handle items with refine levels from +7 to +9.
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 巨力鐵錘]
我只處理精煉等級在+7到+9之間的物品。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Mighty Hammer]
In order to refine the gear you selected you need ^ff9999{0}^000000 and 20,000 zeny as a fee.
Do you have them ready?
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 巨力鐵錘]
為了精煉你選擇的裝備，你需要^ff9999{0}^000000和20,000 Zeny作為費用。
你準備好了嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Mighty Hammer]
I will wait until you are ready.
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 巨力鐵錘]
我會等你準備好。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Mighty Hammer]
It looks like this item will likely fail to be refined.
Well, even if it fails, it only decreases by 1 refine level.
Would you like to continue refining?
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 巨力鐵錘]
看起來這個物品精煉失敗的可能性很大。
不過，即使失敗，精煉等級也只會降低1級。
你要繼續精煉嗎？

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Mighty Hammer]
Ah! Is it the ^0000ffBlacksmith Blessing^000000?
With the Blacksmith Blessing, the equipment won't vanish if the refine fails!
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 巨力鐵錘]
啊！是^0000ff鐵匠的祝福^000000嗎？
使用鐵匠的祝福，即使精煉失敗，裝備也不會消失！

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Mighty Hammer]
For +{0} equipment, refine with^316AC5 {1} unit(s) Blacksmith Blessing^000000 can prevent the equipment from vanishing. Do you want use it to refine?
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 巨力鐵錘]
對於+{0}的裝備，使用^316AC5 {1}個鐵匠的祝福^000000精煉可以防止裝備消失。你要使用它來精煉嗎？

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Mighty Hammer]
For +{0} weapon, refine with^316AC5 {1} unit(s) Blacksmith Blessing^000000 can prevent the equipment from vanishing. Do you want use it to refine?
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 巨力鐵錘]
對於+{0}的武器，使用^316AC5 {1}個鐵匠的祝福^000000精煉可以防止裝備消失。你要使用它來精煉嗎？

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Mighty Hammer]
Only those who overcome fear of failure will obtain a masterpiece.
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 巨力鐵錘]
只有克服對失敗的恐懼，才能打造出傑作。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Mighty Hammer]
Didn't you just say you had everything ready?
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 巨力鐵錘]
你剛才不是說一切都準備好了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Mighty Hammer]
Wait a second...
Do you think I'm stupid?!
You switched the item while I wasn't looking! Get out of here!
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 巨力鐵錘]
等一下...
你以為我傻嗎？！
趁我不注意時你換了物品！給我滾出去！

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Mighty Hammer]
Tac! Tac! Tac!
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 巨力鐵錘]
叮！叮！叮！

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Mighty Hammer]
The sound refreshes my mind every time I hear it.
Here, have it. Refine succeeded flawlessly!
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 巨力鐵錘]
每次聽到這個聲音，我都精神一振。
給你，精煉完美成功！

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Mighty Hammer]
What?!!
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 巨力鐵錘]
什...什麼？！

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Mighty Hammer]
Aiya! I am faceless now. HmHm.
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 巨力鐵錘]
哎呀！我現在臉都丟盡了。哼。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Mighty Hammer]
Oops!!
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 巨力鐵錘]
糟糕！！

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Mighty Hammer]
I am sure a person like you would never blame me for a decrease in refine level by 1. Hmm.
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 巨力鐵錘]
像你這樣的人，肯定不會因為精煉等級降低1級就怪我吧。嗯。

scripts.text:
[Basta]
I'm the best Blacksmith in the whole world, Basta.
But I don't provide a normal refine service.
I only refine equipment ^CC0000over +10^000000.
scripts.translation:
[巴斯塔]
我是全世界最好的鐵匠，巴斯塔。
但我提供不了普通的精煉服務。
我只精煉^CC0000+10以上^000000的裝備。

scripts.text:
[Basta]
Which equipment do you want to refine?
scripts.translation:
[巴斯塔]
你想精煉哪件裝備？

scripts.text: [Basta]
scripts.translation: [巴斯塔]

scripts.text:
[Basta]
Is your head an equipment?
scripts.translation:
[巴斯塔]
你的頭是裝備嗎？

scripts.text:
[Basta]
What do you want me to do?
scripts.translation:
[巴斯塔]
你想讓我做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Basta]
Making artificial hands is not my specialty.
scripts.translation:
[巴斯塔]
製作假手不是我的專長。

scripts.text:
[Basta]
Do you even know what a robe is?
scripts.translation:
[巴斯塔]
你知道什麼是長袍嗎？

scripts.text:
[Basta]
If you want to refine your feet, don't come to me, try running a marathon.
scripts.translation:
[巴斯塔]
如果你想精煉你的腳，別來找我，去跑個馬拉松吧。

scripts.text:
[Basta]
Where is the accessory?
scripts.translation:
[巴斯塔]
飾品在哪裡？

scripts.text:
[Basta]
Well... I don't see any equipment worth refining.
scripts.translation:
[巴斯塔]
嗯...我看不到任何值得精煉的裝備。

scripts.text:
[Basta]
I can't make you smart. Go see a school teacher for that.
scripts.translation:
[巴斯塔]
我沒法讓你變聰明。去找老師吧。

scripts.text:
[Basta]
Even I cannot refine this item. There's no way.
scripts.translation:
[巴斯塔]
連我都無法精煉這件物品。絕對不行。

scripts.text:
[Basta]
Haven't I told you? I only refine equipment that are +10 and above.
scripts.translation:
[巴斯塔]
我沒告訴過你嗎？我只精煉+10及以上的裝備。

scripts.text:
[Basta]
This weapon is perfect, no need to refine it anymore~
scripts.translation:
[巴斯塔]
這把武器已經完美了，不需要再精煉了~

scripts.text:
[Basta]
Hmm... is this the one you want to refine?
To refine this equipment, I need 1 ^ff9999{0}^000000 and {1} zeny as a fee.
Do you really want to refine this?
scripts.translation:
[巴斯塔]
嗯...這就是你想精煉的那件嗎？
精煉這件裝備，我需要1 ^ff9999{0}^000000 和 {1} Zeny 作為費用。
你真的要精煉這件裝備嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Basta]
Okay. If that's what you want...
scripts.translation:
[巴斯塔]
好吧。如果你堅持的話...

scripts.text:
[Basta]
This {0} has already been refined pretty high.
If you try to refine it more, the refine level could decrease.
scripts.translation:
[巴斯塔]
這件 {0} 已經精煉得相當高了。
如果你繼續嘗試精煉，精煉等級可能會下降。

scripts.text:
[Basta]
I am different from the blacksmiths in others places.
It is impossible that the refine level will drop by, say, 3 or 4... that sounds scary.
Here it can only decrease by 1 level.
scripts.translation:
[巴斯塔]
我和其他地方的鐵匠不一樣。
精煉等級不可能一下子掉3級或4級...那聽起來太可怕了。
在這裡，它只會下降1級。

scripts.text:
[Basta]
Compared to other blacksmiths, the risk is smaller.
I've given all precautions. Do you want to try it?
scripts.translation:
[巴斯塔]
與其他鐵匠相比，風險更小。
我已經做好了所有預防措施。你想試試嗎？

scripts.text:
[Basta]
Woah~ Is it the ^316AC5Blacksmith Blessing^000000? It is difficult to get~ But, you have it!
scripts.translation:
[巴斯塔]
哇~是 ^316AC5鐵匠的祝福^000000 嗎？這東西很難獲得~不過，你有！

scripts.text:
[Basta]
For +{0} {1} need ^316AC5{2} unit(s) Blacksmith Blessing^000000 can prevent the equipment from vanishing. Do you want to refine with Blacksmith Blessing?
scripts.translation:
[巴斯塔]
對於 +{0} {1}，需要 ^316AC5{2} 個鐵匠的祝福^000000 來防止裝備消失。你想使用鐵匠的祝福進行精煉嗎？

scripts.text:
[Basta]
Well~
Not challenging at all could also be a kind of wisdom in life.
scripts.translation:
[巴斯塔]
嗯~
完全沒有挑戰，也許也是一種生活智慧。

scripts.text:
[Basta]
Hmm... You didn't bring all the materials needed.
Come back when you have them all.
scripts.translation:
[巴斯塔]
嗯...你沒有帶齊所有需要的材料。
等你備齊了再來吧。

scripts.text:
[Basta]
Wait a second...
Do you think I'm stupid?!
You switched the item while I wasn't looking! Get out of here!
scripts.translation:
[巴斯塔]
等一下...
你以為我傻嗎？！
趁我不注意你換了物品！給我滾出去！

scripts.text: Pow! Pow! Pow! Pow!
scripts.translation: 砰！砰！砰！砰！

scripts.text:
[Basta]
Great! Nicely done!!
I really am the best blacksmith in the whole wide world!
scripts.translation:
[巴斯塔]
太棒了！做得很好！！
我真的是全世界最棒的鐵匠！

scripts.text:
[Basta]
Aaaaaaaaaaak!!!
scripts.translation:
[巴斯塔]
啊啊啊啊啊！！！

scripts.text:
[Basta]
Refining has failed!
The best blacksmith in the world like me...
doesn't guarantee 100% success~
Too bad.
scripts.translation:
[巴斯塔]
精煉失敗了！
像我這樣世界最棒的鐵匠...
也不能保證100%成功~
真可惜。

scripts.text:
[Basta]
Aaaaaaaaaaak!!!
scripts.translation:
[巴斯塔]
啊啊啊啊啊！！！

scripts.text:
[Basta]
Damn it!
Refining has failed and refine level has decreased!
Even the best blacksmith in the world doesn't guarantee 100% success!
Too bad.
scripts.translation:
[巴斯塔]
該死！
精煉失敗，精煉等級下降了！
即使是世界最棒的鐵匠也不能保證100%成功！
真可惜。

scripts.text:
[Basta]
I'll do better next time! Don't worry!
scripts.translation:
[巴斯塔]
下次我會做得更好的！別擔心！
